oldTaskRecords.title: Configure Scorecard Views and Reports
oldTaskRecords.objective: Provide operational oversight, published detail, profile drilldown, category results, trends, and on-demand authorized ranking.
oldTaskRecords.scope: Configure responsive entry/review/admin/published views, supplier-profile grids, overdue and completeness reports, snapshot-aware KPI reporting, category aggregation, current-measure workspace links, and secured overall/commodity rank calculation without persisted rank fields. Add the named overview, history, contribution-progress, review, and reported-data views and complete the 24 ordered menu destinations across the three tab shells. Bind the audience and review-visibility policies supplied by the security work. Set Supplier Scorecards to open Scorecard Overview and the other two tabs to open blank content areas until a menu is selected. Omit My Contribution Tasks; retain all earlier reporting, responsive-view, ranking, and supplier-profile scope.
oldTaskRecords.deliverable: Existing scorecard report/view set plus 24 ordered menu links with secured visibility and the approved Overview, Blank, Blank tab defaults.

predecessorOutputs.description: Verified KPI Value and parent-total calculation handlers.
Existing scorecard record/action security plus three tab-audience policies and an applicable-review authorization policy ready for final menu/view binding.
Usable KPI authoring and immutable-version forms.
Program/version administration forms and Generation Delay object/form/grid.

oldTaskRecords.blockedStatus: Partly waiting. Complete the earlier calculation, security, KPI-form, and Program-form outputs before binding their destinations. Menu labels and destination purposes are decided; only unverified native binding settings wait for supplied support details. Only the Generation Lag Time Increments link additionally waits for its catalogue object/form from the separate scheduling amendment. Existing ranking and report/query inputs still block their affected reporting features.
oldTaskRecords.rationale: Cross-object reporting and secured query ranking require broader technical judgment but not bespoke UI architecture.
oldTaskRecords.assumptions: The three tab shells and grouping labels come from the application task; catalogue privileges and security policies come from their named earlier outputs. Existing task notification links and contribution entry/completion behavior remain in use. No new data object, field, Power BI dataset, or custom audit object is assigned by this amendment.

suppliedInputDescriptions.description: Supply the supported report/query binding needed by the existing views and ranking work; this blocks only the view/query bindings whose native method remains unverified.

Supply tie, exclusion, null-score, population-count, and security-filtering rules for the existing overall and commodity ranking features; the approved tab/menu labels do not wait for a new naming decision.

Supply only unverified supported native menu/default settings, including blank tab content and the applicable-review visibility condition. New view identifiers are produced by the relevant build tasks, not requested as user decisions.

Supply the Generation Lag Time Increment object and administration form from the separate scheduling amendment before completing that one catalogue menu link; other menu and view bindings can proceed.

steps: Create the named overview and supplemental views using the existing configured objects, responsive forms, and native reporting.
Bind the 24 menu items to the stated destinations in the stated tab/group order, and apply the three tab-audience policies plus the applicable-review condition to their navigation visibility.

Apply the three explicit tab default views. Configure no My Contribution Tasks menu, no fourth application tab, no abstract-catalogue administration menu, and no standalone unrestricted Generation Delay creation menu.
accept: The final navigation contains three tabs, nine grouping headers, and 24 menu items: five under Supplier Scorecards, nine under Program Administration, and ten under Program Development.
Opening Supplier Scorecards displays Scorecard Overview. Opening Program Administration or Program Development displays blank content until a menu is selected.
Each of the 24 menu items opens its named object inventory or view, and Scorecards in Review is shown only to users authorized for the applicable reporting cycle.
Program and KPI Versions open through their authoring records, and Generation Delay creation remains through the controlled Program grid action.

The three business catalogue menus permit the assigned business maintainers, while the ten technical catalogue menus require Administrators membership; selecting supported values on consuming forms does not grant maintenance.
Contribution Progress is read only, My Contribution Tasks is absent, and no abstract-catalogue or standalone unrestricted Generation Delay creation menu is introduced.
